## Lan Drop v0.1.0

Point Lan Drop at a folder, start the service, and every device on your network
can reach it from a browser. Scan the QR code or type the address — no app to
install, no account, no cloud.

### Highlights

- **Share several folders** under one virtual root, browsable like a normal file tree
- **Streaming transfers** with a fixed 256 KB buffer — a 100 GB file costs the same memory as a 1 MB one
- **Resumable**: uploads pick up from the bytes already on disk (`X-Offset`), downloads use standard HTTP `Range`
- **Live activity**: direction, speed, elapsed time, and the peer's IP / device for every transfer
- **Listing filters**: hide system-hidden files, dotfiles, or custom names, globs and regular expressions
- **English + 简体中文**, detected on first launch and switchable at any time
- **Read-only mode**, plus a **headless server build** (`-tags server`) for a NAS, Raspberry Pi or Docker
- **Portable**: settings live in `lan-drop.ini` next to the executable
- **Tray-resident**: closing the window keeps the service running; the quit button in the top bar ends it completely

Built with Go + Wails v3 + React. Wails drives the WebView already installed on
your system instead of bundling Chromium, so this is a single executable of
about 13 MB on Windows with no runtime to install.

### Downloads

| Platform | File | Install |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | `Lan Drop-windows-amd64.exe` | Portable — just run it |
| Linux | `Lan Drop-linux-amd64` | `chmod +x "Lan Drop-linux-amd64"`, then run |
| macOS | `Lan Drop-macos-universal.dmg` | Open, drag Lan Drop to Applications |

On first launch, allow the firewall / local network prompt — otherwise other
devices cannot connect. The macOS build is unsigned: right-click → **Open**, or
run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/lan-drop.app`.

### Please read before using

**There is no authentication.** Anyone on the same subnet who knows the address
can read and write the shared folders. Use it on a network you trust, and start
with `-readonly` when sharing with devices you do not control.

Upload resume matches on **file name**, not content: re-selecting a different
file with the same name continues from the wrong offset.

Documentation: [README](https://github.com/CyanHwang/lan-drop#readme) · [简体中文](https://github.com/CyanHwang/lan-drop/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)

## 简体中文

指定一个文件夹并启动服务，同一网络下的设备用浏览器扫码或输入
地址即可访问，不装客户端、不注册、不经云端。

**下载**：Windows 直接运行 `Lan Drop-windows-amd64.exe`；Linux 给
`Lan Drop-linux-amd64` 加执行权限后运行；macOS 打开
`Lan Drop-macos-universal.dmg`，把 Lan Drop 拖进「应用程序」。首次启动请允许
防火墙／局域网权限；macOS 构建未签名，需右键「打开」或用 `xattr` 解除隔离。

**注意**：**没有鉴权**，同网段内任何知道地址的设备都能读写共享目录，请只在
可信网络使用，给不信任的设备看文件时用 `-readonly`。上传续传按文件名匹配，
换了同名但内容不同的文件会从错误位置接着写。

完整说明见 [中文 README](https://github.com/CyanHwang/lan-drop/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)。
